summary.headline: Astrological Questions, Chapters 38–55
summary.text: Continuation of a Florentine codex chapter list, covering astrological answers about flight, confinement, partnerships, sowing, garments, death, prison, journeys, war, rulers, rumors, travel, timing, and identifying objects. The entries prescribe examining Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the Moon, the Sun, the ascendant, zodiac signs, and stellar colors and smells; chapter 54 is omitted.
